name: dTRINITY Staked dUSD
oneLiner: sdUSD is dTRINITY's yield-bearing dUSD vault receipt; staked dUSD is supplied into dLEND and the share price accrues lending yield.
collateral: dUSD deposited into dTRINITY dSTAKE vaults and supplied into dLEND; deployments are chain-isolated and non-fungible across networks.
pegMechanism: Stake dUSD to mint sdUSD vault receipts and unstake back into dUSD when dLEND liquidity is available; dSTAKE charges no staking fee, unstaking can incur up to 10 bps retained by the vault, and NAV appreciates as dLEND supply APY accrues.

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver through parent, reserve, custody, variant, or text-signal exposure; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: sdUSD is a dUSD strategy-vault receipt and inherits upstream dUSD/dTRINITY protocol controls and reserve dependencies.

notices.title: Liquidity-gated unstaking
notices.message: sdUSD unstaking depends on available dUSD liquidity in dLEND; when utilization is high, holders may need to wait for borrowers to repay or sell sdUSD on secondary markets.

mintAuthority.summary: sdUSD is dTRINITY's staked dUSD vault receipt; shares are minted only by staking dUSD into the dSTAKE vault (supplied into dLEND), so it inherits dUSD's AMO-or-custodian-hybrid mint authority rather than creating new dUSD supply.

controls.label: dSTAKE sdUSD vault (share accounting)
controls.evidence: sdUSD receipts are minted when dUSD is staked into the dSTAKE vault and supplied into dLEND, and burned (up to 10 bps retained) on liquidity-gated unstake; NAV accrues dLEND supply APY. The wrapper cannot create base dUSD supply. Deployments are chain-isolated and non-fungible across networks.

controls.label: Inherited dUSD AMO/governed-reserve mint authority
controls.evidence: Underlying dUSD is minted 1:1 against a governance-set whitelist of reserve stablecoins, with AMO pre-minting dUSD into Curve pools and contributor governance (pre-TGE multisig) controlling the whitelist, AMO/SMO, and a mint kill-switch. sdUSD inherits this concentrated-admin posture, plus the March 17 2026 dTRINITY exploit exposure noted on the dUSD profile.

review.evidence: sdUSD (variantOf dusd-dtrinity, variantKind strategy-vault) is a dSTAKE vault receipt over dUSD on Ethereum and Fraxtal. It inherits dUSD's amo-or-custodian-hybrid mint path and concentrated-admin posture; the wrapper only mints/burns receipts against dUSD deposits supplied into dLEND.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Classified as the staked variant of dusd-dtrinity per coin metadata; posture mirrored from the parent dUSD mintAuthority. The dSTAKE vault's own admin was not independently resolved on-chain.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the dSTAKE sdUSD vault admin/upgrade controls on Ethereum and Fraxtal and confirm exposure scope of the March 2026 dTRINITY/dLEND exploit on the staking path.
